title: Add the reader-facing framework: part opener, glossary and the first visual tranche
source_handoff: external review of the Edition 1 draft, findings R23-R25 and visuals V1-V12
acceptance_criteria: The near-empty Concepts divider becomes an intentional part opener with a two-sentence lead and a pointer to the concept map
A glossary is the single definition site for the canonical terms the review lists, including the four gap kinds and the strict/relaxed distinction

Tranche 1 figures are authored with a book-owned PlantUML source, form and evidence-status labels, an adjacent text equivalent, no embedded figure number, and a figure-manifest entry: the Chapter 2 architecture decision tree, the Chapter 15 formal freshness timeline, and the Chapter 17 benchmark-reading checklist
The V2 six-family comparison and V11 checklist are tables rather than images
No figure asserts a number of its own; an observed-result figure names the claim it illustrates
Page count and book length are recorded after tranche 1, and tranche 2 is only started once that is reviewed
expected_artifacts: tranche-1 figures with sources and manifest entries
